development-continuation.default_hint: The administrator baseline is used by default. Only an explicitly selected candidate from this task becomes the new code input.
development-continuation.enabled_hint: Choose an exact sealed candidate from this task's previous terminal run. The first candidate is not selected automatically.
development-continuation.boundary: This continues code only. Previous tests and acceptance are not inherited. The new run still requires independent testing and human acceptance.
development-continuation.loading: Reading exact candidates for the current task…
development-continuation.empty: No sealed continuation candidate is currently available. Opt out or read again.
development-continuation.reason.task_acc: This task has been formally accepted. Continue through a new iteration requirement rather than modifying the accepted task.
development-continuation.reason.no_run: This task has no previous run to continue.
development-continuation.reason.run_not_: The previous run is not terminal yet. Resolve the original run before reading continuation candidates again.
development-continuation.reason.no_seale: No eligible sealed candidate is currently available from the previous run. Explicitly opt out or check the original candidate and read again.
development-continuation.changed: The candidate source changed. The previous choice was cleared. Read again and choose explicitly.
development-continuation.view_required: Read the current account, organization and project before choosing a code source.
development-continuation.invalid_options: The candidate response could not be verified. Read it again.
development-continuation.invalid_binding: The continuation basis could not be verified and cannot confirm the code input.
development-continuation.source_versions: Source task version {{task}} · source run version {{run}}
